title: Known network list profiles
whyItMatters: This key records every network the machine has joined, including SSIDs and gateways. It reveals where the computer has been connected.
source: Windows Network List service registry: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/netlistapi (NetworkList\Profiles subkeys, well-known forensic artifact)
notes: HKLM machine-wide key; individual per-network GUID subkeys are counted but their values are not read. Registry last-write time is unavailable.
